en: I stand where the river meets the sea, / my feet in salt, my head in sun. / Twice a day the tide comes in to visit, / and twice a day it turns to run.
I hold the shore in my fingers: / a tangle of roots like stilts and knees. / When storm waves come running at the land, / I slow them down and soften their seas.
Between my roots the small ones hide: / young fish, shrimp and scuttling crabs. / They grow up safe in my muddy rooms, / then swim out into the open sea.
My roots catch mud the rivers carry, / and slowly, slowly, land is made. / My leaves breathe in the air's extra carbon / and lock it deep in mud and shade.
So when you walk along the boardwalk, / and hear the water lap and sigh, / remember me, the coast's old guardian, / and let me grow, and do not let me die.
id: Aku berdiri di tempat sungai bertemu laut, / kakiku di air asin, kepalaku di bawah matahari. / Dua kali sehari pasang datang bertamu, / dan dua kali sehari ia surut pergi.
Kugenggam pantai dengan jari-jariku: / akar-akar berjalin seperti tongkat dan lutut. / Saat ombak badai berlari ke daratan, / kuperlambat langkahnya, kubuat ia surut.
Di sela akarku yang kecil bersembunyi: / ikan muda, udang, dan kepiting yang berlari. / Mereka tumbuh aman di kamar-kamarku yang berlumpur, / lalu berenang ke laut lepas yang luas sekali.
Akarku menangkap lumpur yang dibawa sungai, / dan pelan-pelan, daratan pun tercipta. / Daunku menghirup karbon dari udara / dan menyimpannya dalam lumpur dan teduhnya.
Maka saat kau berjalan di titian kayu, / mendengar air berbisik dan mendesah, / ingatlah aku, penjaga pantai yang tua, / biarkan aku tumbuh, jangan biarkan aku musnah.

objectives.id: Membaca puisi yang ditulis dengan suara makhluk hidup dan menjelaskan pesannya.

connection.en: Mangroves protect coasts, shelter young sea creatures and store carbon.

connection.en: Indonesia has some of the largest mangrove forests in the world.
connection.id: Indonesia memiliki salah satu hutan bakau terluas di dunia.

offlineActivity.en: Write a poem of three or four stanzas in the voice of something in nature near you, such as a rice field, a river or a big tree. Include at least two true facts about it and one comparison.
offlineActivity.id: Tulis puisi tiga atau empat bait dengan suara sesuatu di alam sekitarmu, misalnya sawah, sungai, atau pohon besar. Masukkan sedikitnya dua fakta yang benar tentangnya dan satu perbandingan.

factChecks.claim: Mangroves grow in salty or brackish water where rivers meet the sea.
Many coasts have two high and two low tides a day; some Indonesian coasts have one or a mixed pattern.
Mangrove roots slow waves and help protect coasts.
Young fish, shrimp and crabs shelter among mangrove roots.
Mangroves trap sediment and store carbon in their mud.
Indonesia has some of the largest mangrove areas in the world.
